summary: JBDI Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 23, 2026, announcing a 1-for-2 reverse stock split to regain compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price rule (5550(a)(2)). The split, effective June 29, 2026, reduces outstanding shares from ~19.0M to ~9.5M, with par value increasing to $0.001. No fractional shares will be issued; fractions will be rounded up. Trading on a split-adjusted basis begins June 30 under ticker JBDI. This is a routine compliance action, not a special situation.
